svg.aria-label: Failure detection in the style of SWIM, used by Consul and Serf. Node A pings node B and gets no reply in time. Instead of declaring B dead, A asks two other nodes, C and D, to ping B for it. If neither gets a reply, B is marked suspect and that suspicion is gossiped; B has a short grace period to refute it. Only then is B declared dead. Indirect probes avoid false alarms when only the link between A and B is bad.
